name: Webotee — Amazon Product Research MCP
author: Webotee
description: Amazon brand, seller, niche & buy-box intelligence inside your own Claude or ChatGPT — a research connector for sellers.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Keyword search over product titles/descriptions; returns brand, price, 30-day demand, fulfillment and rating.

tools.name: top_sourcing_picks
tools.description: Top sourcing-pick ASINs across the catalog with price, category, brand, gating and velocity filters.

tools.name: evaluate_asin_sourcing
tools.description: Score one ASIN for FBA sourcing: composite 0-100 plus velocity, gating, friction, margin and brand posture.

tools.name: asin_profit_calc
tools.description: Estimate whether an ASIN hits a target margin given buy-box price, FBA fees and referral fee; or breakeven COGS.

tools.name: asin_comparables
tools.description: Find ASINs similar to a given ASIN by brand, price band and seller count.

tools.name: asin_buybox_history
tools.description: Buy-box seller history for an ASIN over the observed window.

tools.name: collect_asin_now
tools.description: On-demand single-ASIN snapshot (current title, price, today's offers) plus historical intelligence.

tools.name: evaluate_brand
tools.description: Brand-level read: control posture, winner diversity, Amazon/FBA share, churn, demand and top ASINs.

tools.name: brand_buybox_trajectory
tools.description: A brand's buy-box winner trajectory over time.

tools.name: brand_new_asins
tools.description: A brand's newly-appeared ASINs.

tools.name: brand_similar
tools.description: Brands similar to a given brand by category, price tier and competition.

tools.name: brand_under_attack
tools.description: Detect competitive attack: a surge in new sellers, buy-box churn or price drops.

tools.name: brands_gaining_sellers
tools.description: Brands gaining sellers (rising-competition signal).

tools.name: brands_in_operator_network
tools.description: Brands that share sellers with a target brand — the operator graph.

tools.name: find_undercompeted_brands
tools.description: Brands with low seller competition but real sales presence (the flagship discovery tool).

tools.name: find_brands_with_high_seller_churn
tools.description: Brands with high buy-box / seller churn.

tools.name: find_deconcentrating_brands
tools.description: Brands whose seller concentration is falling.

tools.name: find_single_seller_brands
tools.description: Brands held by a single dominant seller.

tools.name: filter_brands_by_fba_share
tools.description: Brands filtered by FBA share of the buy box.

tools.name: top_velocity_brands
tools.description: Highest sales-velocity brands.

tools.name: category_undercompeted_brands
tools.description: Under-competed brands within a specific category.

tools.name: find_new_operators
tools.description: Brand-new sellers that recently started selling.

tools.name: operator_compare
tools.description: Two sellers head-to-head: brand, ASIN and category overlap and marketplace presence.

tools.name: operator_top_brands
tools.description: The brands a seller carries most, by estimated 30-day sales.

tools.name: operator_top_asins
tools.description: The ASINs a seller wins most, by estimated 30-day sales, with buy-box share.

tools.name: operator_brands_by_competition
tools.description: A seller's brands ranked by fewest competing sellers.

tools.name: operator_category_dominance
tools.description: Which categories a seller dominates.

tools.name: operator_new_brands
tools.description: Brands a seller recently added.

tools.name: operator_lost_brands
tools.description: Brands a seller recently dropped.

tools.name: top_expanding_operators
tools.description: Sellers expanding fastest by adding brands.

tools.name: filter_operators_by_fba_share
tools.description: Sellers filtered by FBA share.

tools.name: find_underserved_niches
tools.description: Under-served sub-categories with real demand and room to compete, ranked by private-label winnability.

tools.name: evaluate_category_for_private_label
tools.description: Is a category/niche winnable for a new private-label brand? Per-signal pass/fail verdict.

tools.name: category_metrics
tools.description: Per-category metrics: sellers, demand and concentration.

tools.name: category_new_entrants
tools.description: Brands/sellers newly entering a category.

tools.name: category_top_growers
tools.description: Fastest-growing brands in a category.

tools.name: categories_amazon_retreating
tools.description: Categories where Amazon retail is retreating — openings for third-party sellers.

tools.name: competitive_landscape
tools.description: Top sellers by buy-box days and top brands by winner-diversity for a brand or category.

tools.name: xmkt_pricing_compare
tools.description: Matched Amazon vs Walmart pricing, delta % and a coarse FBA profitability check.

tools.name: brand_xmarket
tools.description: A brand's Amazon vs Walmart cross-marketplace presence.

tools.name: operator_xmarket_presence
tools.description: A seller's Amazon vs Walmart presence.

tools.name: gating_repricing_advice
tools.description: Ungate / arbitrage / avoid recommendation for an ASIN with a metric-cited rationale.

tools.name: set_cost_floor
tools.description: Set your cost floor for an ASIN or brand (workspace setting).

tools.name: map_violations_today
tools.description: Active MAP (Minimum Advertised Price) violations for products in your workspace.

tools.name: unauthorized_sellers
tools.description: Given a brand and your authorized-seller list, flag unauthorized sellers.

tools.name: risk_assessment
tools.description: Composite risk score for an ASIN or brand: MAP events, unauthorized sellers and recommended actions.

tools.name: watchlist_add
tools.description: Create or add to a saved tracking list (ASINs, brands, sellers, niches); captures a baseline.

tools.name: watchlist_add_rule
tools.description: Add an alert rule to a watchlist.

tools.name: watchlist_list
tools.description: List your watchlists and their items.

tools.name: watchlist_delta
tools.description: What changed since the watchlist's baseline.

tools.name: watchlist_diff
tools.description: Diff two watchlist snapshots.

tools.name: watchlist_remove
tools.description: Remove items or a whole watchlist.
